afterInvariant().notice: Logs how much of each action actually executed (coverage evidence, -vv).

failed().notice: Returns true if any test assertion has failed.

invariant_balanceCoversLiability_surplus.notice: balance >= liability, and the surplus is exactly the stray transfers

invariant_liabilityEqualsOpenContributio.notice: totalEscrowLiability == sum over pots of (unsettled, un-refunded contributions)

invariant_noPotBothSettledAndRefunded().notice: No pot is both settled and (even partly) refunded, including via the valve.

invariant_recipientsPaidGoalExactlyOnce(.notice: Each non-handler recipient holds exactly the sum of goals of its settled pots

invariant_refundsBoundedAndExclusiveWith.notice: No one refunded more than contributed (and exactly contributed when flagged); no pot is both settled and refunded; settled pots are fully funded.

invariant_settleAndRefundGatingExact().notice: settle never succeeds after the window / twice / on an unfunded pot, and always succeeds inside the window on a fully funded unsettled pot. Likewise refund legality (incl. the valve) is exact.

invariant_tokenConservation().notice: token conservation: everything in minus everything out

invariant_unsettledPotEscrowSplitsIntoRe.notice: Valve refunds only ever return a contributor's own contribution (conservation of the pot's escrow): the sum refunded + still-owed for an unsettled pot equals totalFunded.

targetSenders().notice: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).

test_handlerValvePathExecutes().notice: Valve path, deterministically: fully funded pot, settle before the window, refund only after it.
